name.notes: Responds warmly to her name said softly; does not like being called 'Grandma' by anyone outside family.

family.name: Priya
family.notes: Lives in another city, calls when she can. Asha asks about her often, especially in the evenings.

family.name: Rohan
family.notes: Local, visits on weekends. Primary caregiver account holder for this demo.

family.name: Vikram
family.notes: Passed away several years ago. Asha sometimes asks for him, especially when tired or anxious. Sensitive topic — see 'avoid' notes.

life_story.work: Retired schoolteacher, taught primary school for over 30 years
key_events: Married Vikram in her early twenties
Raised two children, Priya and Rohan
Loved teaching and often talks about former students
Moved in with Rohan's family after Vikram passed away

topics: Family memories from when the children were young
routines: Sitting by the window in the morning
A short walk if someone is with her

topics: Direct statements about Vikram's death — she is aware but revisiting the fact directly can cause distress; redirect gently instead of restating it
avoid.notes: This list is caregiver-set and editable. It is not AI-guessed. If a topic here starts to feel like it's preventing Asha from processing something she needs to, that's a real tension — see docs/guardrails.md open question.

daily_routine.notes: Medication reminders only — Sahaara never advises on dosing, see docs/guardrails.md.
